content.plain: Composition feeds the output of one map into the input of another.
content.exact: For f:X→Y and g:Y→Z, (g∘f):X→Z is defined by (g∘f)(x)=g(f(x)).
content.caveat: Order matters: g∘f need not equal f∘g.
